QUOTE: "None of these are in `library/`. The library itself spawns nothing." and "Every lock goes through one identity, `mutex->mutex` (`threading.c:81`)" / "`library/threading.c` is wholly gated on it"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library spawns no threads, but it never states that library/ supplies the mutex abstraction for threaded callers. It frames the mutex code as compiled out by default and lists the lock sites instead, so the contrast is not stated.
